acceptable_paraphrases: The number of vertices minus the number of edges plus the number of faces equals two
critical_errors: Omitting one or more terms in the equation
misconceptions: believing that the result can be any number other than 2
mixing up the order of operations in the formula
confusing the roles of vertices, edges, and faces
grading_notes: Ensure the equation is correctly applied with all terms present. Accept variations in notation but require correct arithmetic.
